test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Catherine said she loved Heathcliff, however**, she could not marry him because of his social standing.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. 'But'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence provided contains two contrasting ideas: Catherine loved Heathcliff, but she could not marry him due to his social standing.
 
• The correct conjunction to connect two contrasting ideas is **"but"**, as it implies a contradiction or contrast.
